verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships AI features (AI code reviewer, Rovo, AI-powered workflows), so a buyer can fairly ask whether their data can be kept out of model training; the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented AI-training opt-out or no-training commitment. Encryption, 2FA/IP allowlisting and SOC2/ISO/GDPR compliance are adjacent security controls, not a training-data control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
